Dedicated to ME!!!!!!!!

July 12, 2006

Hey! I got a song dedicated to me!! It’s so amazing. “Why Worry By Dire Straits”. Am in love with this song already! Guess who dedicated it to me!!???

Yep! Thats right… “Me!” :D. When motivation can’t find you, you find it!!
